item.title: Boyd Buchanan Coach Matt Hoppe Thankful to Celebrate Bucs Trip to Final Four
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) The Boyd basketball team punched their ticket to the state final four over the weekend for the first time in 30-years. The joy was even greater for head coach Matt Hoppe, who was sidelined for awhile after suffering a heart attack in January. Brian Armstrong reports. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
